meta.name: flowio
meta.description: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 2.0, 3.0, and 3.1 files with FlowIO. Use for low-level FCS metadata and channel inspection, NumPy event extraction, multi-dataset files, table export, and FCS 3.1 creation; use FlowKit for compensation, cytometry transforms, gating, or FlowJo workspaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取、检查和写入流式细胞术FCS文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理FCS格式的流式细胞术数据文件
copy.tagline_en: Read, inspect, and write Flow Cytometry FCS files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with FCS files from flow cytometry experiments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能读取和解析 FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 流式细胞术文件,提取事件为 NumPy 数组,查看通道与元数据,将数据导出为 CSV,或创建新的 FCS 3.1 文件。
howto.when: 当任务涉及读取或解析 FCS 文件、提取事件数据、导出表格等流式细胞术数据操作时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 FCS 文件,列出所有通道和事件数。
say.note: Claude 会解析 FCS 并返回通道、事件数等。

say.text: 把事件数据导出为 CSV 文件。
say.note: Claude 会将事件数组写入 CSV 并保存。

say.text: 用这三列数据创建一个新的 FCS 文件。
say.note: Claude 会生成 FCS 3.1 文件。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can read and parse FCS 2.0/3.0/3.1 files, extract events as NumPy arrays, inspect channels and metadata, export data to CSV, and create new FCS 3.1 files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves reading or parsing FCS files, extracting event data, or exporting tables in flow cytometry data processing.

say_en.text: Read this FCS file and list all channels and event count.
say_en.note: Claude parses the file, returning channels and event count.

say_en.text: Export the event data to a CSV file.
say_en.note: Claude will write the events array to CSV.

say_en.text: Create a new FCS file from these three columns.
say_en.note: Claude will call create_fcs to generate an FCS 3.1 file.
